column1: # Virtual address memory: the NPDM declares a system resource (24 MB in the base, 48 MB in update 131072), so the SDK's IsVirtualAddressMemoryEnabled is true. The game
# takes both a 6.2 GB heap (nninitStartup: SetHeapSize 0x18ce00000) and an address region of the rest of the pool (main+0x9c2130) after the 1 GB node area (its sdk has
# no reviewed node-area implementation). 256 MB in front + 4.5 GB alias region + 256 MB stack region + 9 GB heap region (the note, What it needs). A 256 MB heap region
# (mem_reserve 0x2d0000000, mem_alias 0x2a0000000) stops the boot at SetHeapSize (OOM: req 0x18ce00000 > cap 0x10000000; 2026-11-06)
# The packed version's NPDM's (pack_android.py takes it from the NPDM; this is the value for update 131072)
# The NPDM's cores (ThreadInfo cores 0-5, main thread core 0), as on every Switch 2 application: GetInfo(CoreMask) answers them (pack_android.py takes the NPDM's)
